        a) BYLAW NO. 1727
           "Langford Zoning Bylaw, Amendment No. 501, (1300 Glenshire Dr), 201711.

Acting Mayor Sahlstrom opened the Public Hearing for Bylaw No. 1727 at 5:31 p.m.

Acting Mayor Sahlstrom advised members of the audience that any person present who believes
                                                                                                    that his
or her interest is affected by the proposed bylaws shall be given an opportunity to be heard on
                                                                                                the matters
contained in the proposed bylaw. Those who wish to speak concerning this proposed bylaw should
                                                                                                       give
their name, address and views concerning the proposed bylaw. Acting Mayor Sahlstrom advised that
                                                                                                      after
everyone has expressed their views, he shall state three times "Is there anyone else who wishes to
                                                                                                         be
heard", and if no further views are forthcoming, the Public Hearing shall be declared closed.

                                                                                               November 20th, 2017
                                                                                                       Page 2 of 13

The City Planner advised that Mark Johnston of M.H. Johnston and
                                                                 Associates Inc. has applied on behalf
of 1103097 BC Ltd. to amend the zoning of 1300 Glenshire Drive (now
                                                                    1300 Valemount Court) from the
RR4 (Rural Residential 4) Zone to the RM2A (Attached Housing) Zone.

This is being proposed in order to allow for the development of approximately
                                                                              100 townhouse units on a
private roadway. As part of this application, a Public Hearing is required
                                                                               in accordance with the
regulations of the Local Government Act.

In support of these/this application, the applicant has agreed to provide
                                                                            the following:

1. $6,000 per Single Family Equivalent dwelling unit to the General Amenity
                                                                              Reserve Fund;
2. $1,000 per Single Family Equivalent dwelling unit to the Affordable Housing
                                                                                Reserve Fund;
3. A detailed site plan illustrating the proposed development, retention of
                                                                              at least 30% of the site as
     open space, and an emergency access route;
4. A stormwater management plan; and
5. A Section 219 Covenant securing the open space retention, construction of
                                                                                frontage improvements,
     construction of a left hand turn lane onto West Shore Parkway, stormwater
                                                                                           management
     improvements, an adequate water supply, advisory notes for future owners regarding
                                                                                                potential
     nuisances, and a statutory right-of-way for the emergency access; and
6. A road dedication plan to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering.

The applicant has submitted the detailed site plan and stormwater management
                                                                                  plan, as required, prior
to this Public Hearing. This proposal is consistent with the Official Community
                                                                                Plan Hillside or Shoreline
designation, and notifications and advertisements have been placed as required by
                                                                                    Council policy.

It should be noted that the map for Bylaw No. 1727 inadvertently included a
                                                                               portion of the site located
south of Glenshire Drive. This portion will not be included in the proposed townhouse
                                                                                        development, and
staff will bring forward a Bylaw to amend the designation of this property as part
                                                                                     of a future Omnibus
amendment.

Acting Mayor Sahlstrom called a first time for presentations.

None presented.

Acting Mayor Sahlstrom called a second time for presentations.

None presented.

Acting Mayor Sahlstrom called a third and final time for presentation, there being
                                                                                   none, Acting Mayor
Sahlstrom officially declared the Public Hearing for Bylaw No. 1727 closed at  5:34 p.m.

source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council:

     1.   Direct staff to proceed with consideration of the following variances for the proposed
          construction of an addition to the existing one-family dwelling, as generally shown on Appendix
          C of this report, at 2579 Rainville Road:

          i.    That Section 6.21.06(1)(a) of Zoning Bylaw No. 300 be varied to reduce the minimum
                setback from the rear lot line from 6.0 m (20 ft) to 2.7 m (9 ft); and
          I.    That Section 6.1.2(c) of Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw No. 1000 be varied to
                defer the installation of on-site plumbing from prior to the issuance of an Occupancy Permit
                for the proposed addition to within six months of a sewer main being installed in a highway
                or City statutory right-of-way abutting the property at 2579 Rainville Road;

Subject to the following terms and conditions:

          i.    That the site is developed in substantial accordance with the plans attached to this report
                as Appendix C;

                                                                                                 November 20th, 2017
                                                                                                         Page 7 of 13


         ii.    That the owner registers a Section 219 Covenant, in priority of all other charges, prior
                                                                                                         to the
                issuance of this Development Variance Permit that agrees that all required on-site
                                                                                                     plumbing
                will be installed and connected to the municipal sanitary sewer system within six months
                                                                                                             of
                a sewer main being installed in a highway or City statutory right-of-way abutting the
                                                                                                        parcel;
         iii.   That the owner pays the required Sewer Capital Recovery Fee (SCRF) to West Shore
                Environmental Services or the City of Langford prior to the issuance of a Building Permit
                authorizing the construction of the proposed addition at 2579 Rainville Road; and
         iv.    That the owner provides confirmation of adequate septic field capacity for the proposed
                addition containing a shop and secondary suite from Island Health prior to the issuance of a
                Building Permit authorizing the construction of the proposed addition at 2579 Rainville
                Road.

source_identity.raw_motion_text:
That Council:

    1.   Direct staff to prepare a bylaw to:

           a.   Amend the zoning designation of the properties located at 808, 812 and 820 Arncote
                Avenue; 2636, 2640, and 2646 Peatt Road; and 2641, 2647 and 2649 Sunderland Road from
                R2 (One- and Two-Family Residential) to MU2 (Mixed-Use Residential Commercial) to
                permit the construction of two multi-family residential buildings with approximately 206
                dwelling; and

           b. Add the following to Section 6.56.06 of Zoning Bylaw No. 300:

                i.   No buildings or structures on the properties legally described as Parcel A (DD 009-W),
                     Lot 12, Section 111, Esquimalt District, Plan 10901 (808 Arncote Avenue); That part of
                     Lot 12, Section 111, Esquimalt District, Plan 10901 lying to the west of a straight
                     boundary joining the points of bisection of the northerly and southerly boundaries of
                     said lot (812 Arncote Avenue); Lot 7, Section 111, Esquimalt District, Plan 10901 (820
                     Arncote Avenue); Lot B, Section 111, Esquimalt District, Plan 9793 (2636 Peatt Road);
                     Lot C, Section 111, Esquimalt District, Plan 9793 (2640 Peatt Road); Lot 13, Section 111,
                     Esquimalt District, Plan 10901 (2646 Peatt Road); Lot 9, Section 111, Esquimalt District,
                     Plan 10901 (2641 Sunderland Road); and Lot 8, Section 111, Esquimalt District, Plan
                     10901 (2647/2649 Sunderland Road) may exceed a height of seven storeys;

Subject to the following terms and conditions:

                                                                                               November 20th, 2017
                                                                                                        Page 8 of 13


              That the owner agrees to provide, as a bonus for increased density, the following
              contributions per Single Family Equivalent (SFE) created, prior to Building Permit Issuance:

              a. $6,000 towards the General Amenity Reserve Fund;
              b. 1,000 towards the Affordable Housing Reserve Fund;

       ii.    That the applicant provides, prior to Public Hearing, the following items:

                  a. Detailed site, elevation and floor plans demonstrating substantial compliance with the
                     Multi-Family Design Guidelines to the satisfaction of the Director Planning;
                  b. A Traffic Impact Assessment, to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering and the
                     Ministry of Transportation, evaluating left turn movements from Arncote Avenue onto
                     Peatt Road, impacts on surrounding streets and on the Peatt Road and Veterans
                     Memorial Parkway intersection, and recommending improvements to the
                     transportation network; and
                  c. A Technical Memo, to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering, providing a
                     preliminary assessment of the area, consideration of stormwater management options
                     and confirmation that the requirements of Bylaw No. 1000 will be met;

              That the applicant provides, prior to Bylaw Adoption, a Section 219 covenant, registered in
              priority of all other charges on title, that agrees to the following:

                  a. That the owner shall construct all improvements and works recommended by the
                     approved Traffic Impact Assessment, to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering,
                     prior to the issuance of a Building Permit;
                  b. That the owner shall construct all frontage improvements, works and services
                     according to the standards of the Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw No.
                     1000 prior to the issuance of a Building Permit;
                  c. That the owner shall construct the driveway access for the proposed development
                     from either Arncote Avenue or Sunderland Road, to the satisfaction of the Director of
                     Engineering and in accordance with the approved Traffic Impact Assessment; and
                  d. That the owner shall prepare a stormwater management plan and construct all on- and
                     off-site works required in the approved stormwater management plan, to the
                     satisfaction of the Director of Engineering, prior to the issuance of a Building Permit.
